## Chapter 5B Routing — High-Recall Evidence Calibration

**Ruler:** Andrés Manuel López Obrador (AMLO)
**Period:** 2018–2024
**Source:** BOOK-013 / CIDOB political biography

---

### Routing Decisions

| chunk_id | Decision | Question IDs | Relevance Finding | Adjacent Context | Exclusion Reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **U0001** | **EXCLUDE** | — | No material evidence | Basic biographical scaffold (name, dates, party, office) is necessary to establish ruler identity; table-of-contents/header structure provides navigation architecture | Navigation boilerplate, institutional front-matter, generic biographical identifiers; none independently meet the evidence test |
| **U0002** | **EXCLUDE** | — | No material evidence | "Videoescándalo" (corrupt subordinate practices under PRD DF government) and "intenso calado social" in municipal management are mentioned but lack specificity on outcomes, costs, or distributional results | Political history narrative; generic characterizations of municipal social impact without concrete policy actions, measured outcomes, or implementation specifics |
| **U0003** | **EXCLUDE** | — | No material evidence | Electoral contestation narrative (2006 "robo" / "Coalición por el Bien de Todos" / "Gobierno alterno" / "presidente legítimo") — political legitimacy dispute, not economic policy | Electoral protest narrative; no 5B-lens policy action, outcome, cost, or distributional finding |
| **U0004** | **EXCLUDE** | — | No material evidence | Opposition period (2012–2018) general stance against EPN reforms (energy, education, labor, telecommunications) and critique of narco-war effectiveness — characterization of opposition posture, not enacted policy | Opposition political narrative; no enacted fiscal, tax, debt, monetary, competition, or budget policy; critique of predecessor's policies is not evidence of the ruler's own economic governance |
| **U0005** | **INCLUDE** | **5B.1**, 5B.6, 5B.10 | Concrete 2018 campaign economic program: "austeridad republicana" (reorienting current expenditures to investment without tax increases), "precios de garantía" for domestic agricultural producers, import-substitution for gasoline, energy/food self-sufficiency, anti-corruption pledges, social transfers for poverty and violence-affected populations | Campaign platform as precursor to executed budget priorities; economic orientation ("socialdemocracia pragmática" + orthodox macro stability) provides programmatic intent for 5B.1 agenda assessment | Campaign promises become enacted policy and budget; the stated reorientation of public spending priorities and specific programmatic goals (gasoline production, agricultural price supports) constitute a documented policy program directly bearing on whether broad-based prosperity vs. rent/loyalty drove the agenda |
| **U0006** | **INCLUDE** | **5B.1**, **5B.2**, 5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.6, 5B.7, 5B.10 | December 2018 inauguration actions: "austeridad republicana" (renouncing dispendious presidential attributes), "Consulta Nacional Ciudadana" on priority programs, "Plan Nacional de Paz y Seguridad" with Guardia Nacional creation and conditional amnesty, economic platform explicitly combining orthodox macro stability (free-market, budget discipline, peso float) with rejection of privatization/foreignization of strategic sectors | First policy actions of the administration; "no traicionar al pueblo" + "respetar orden legal establecido" pledge; "Cuarta Transformación" constitutional consultation; anti-corruption commitment ("hacer justicia sin venganza") | First concrete governing actions and stated economic philosophy; the documented combination of orthodox macro commitments + stated rejection of privatization in strategic sectors + citizen consultation mechanism directly bears on 5B.1 (agenda intent) and 5B.3 (fiscal/monetary credibility) |
| **U0007** | **EXCLUDE** | — | No material evidence | Migration caravan dynamics, USMCA characterization ("beneficial" per AMLO), Trump border closure threat — external trade/migration context, not AM

LO's domestic economic policy | External shock context (migration, trade renegotiation) relevant to 5B.9 shock-management framing, but this chunk contains only geopolitical characterization, not the ruler's policy response with specific measures, funding, targeting, or monitoring | Migration/trade geopolitical narrative; no enacted domestic economic policy, targeted shock measures, or budget reallocation |
| **U0008** | **EXCLUDE** | — | No material evidence | Table of contents and early biography (childhood in Tabasco, father's small store, baseball, Catholic background) — formative personal history entirely prior to any governing role | Personal biographical narrative; childhood context has no bearing on any 5B economic governance question |
| **U0009** | **EXCLUDE** | — | No material evidence | University enrollment (UNAM Political Science), PRI entry (1976 campaign for Carlos Pellicer), early Tabasco public service (INI delegation, COPLAMAR) — pre-governance career | Pre-governance political career; no enacted economic policy in any period relevant to 5B assessment |
| **U0010** | **EXCLUDE** | — | No material evidence | Early Tabasco party career (CEPES director, 1983 PRI state committee president under González Pedrero) — party apparatus role, not economic policy | Party institutional career; no enacted economic policy in any period relevant to 5B assessment |

---

### Summary

| Metric | Count |
|---|---|
| Total chunks evaluated | 10 |
| **Included** | 2 (U0005, U0006) |
| **Excluded** | 8 |
| Lenses with at least one citing chunk | 5B.1, 5B.2, 5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.6, 5B.7, 5B.10 |

**Included chunks by lens:**

- **5B.1** (legislative/budget agenda for broad-based prosperity): U0005 (austeridad republicana, social transfers, import-substitution program, anti-corruption pledge), U0006 (inauguration actions, 4T framework, orthodox macro + anti-privatization stance)
- **5B.2** (qualified economic professionals / operational independence): U0006 (explicit appointment/independence framing in stated economic philosophy)
- **5B.3** (credible fiscal/tax/debt/monetary rules): U0006 (orthodox macro commitments: budget discipline, peso float, rejection of privatization — bears on rule credibility)
- **5B.4** (fair competition/entrepreneurship/property/trade/investment laws): U0006 (rejection of "extranjerización" of strategic sectors + "producción nacional" priority)
- **5B.6** (budget producing infrastructure, education, health, administrative capacity): U0005 (explicit budget reorientation from current to investment expenditures; agricultural price supports; gasoline production increase), U0006 (Consulta Nacional Ciudadana on priority programs — implementation mechanism)
- **5B.7** (reliable economic information / independent evaluation / correction): U0006 (citizen consultation mechanism + anti-corruption "hacer justicia sin venganza" + "no traicionar al pueblo")
- **5B.10** (stronger/durable economic trajectory vs. inherited): U0005 (self-sufficiency goals, anti-corruption, social investment), U0006 (4T framework, stated economic philosophy)

**Note:** Lenses 5B.5 (anti-corruption enforcement against connected actors), 5B.8 (fair distribution of gains/burdens), and 5B.9 (shock response with targeted measures) are not yet supported by the included chunks. U0006 provides adjacent context for 5B.5 (anti-corruption rhetoric), but no concrete enforcement action, prosecution, audit cooperation, or remedy finding is present in these chunks. The migration/trade context in U0007 is adjacent to 5B.9 shock conditions but contains no enacted response measures.
